name: Muse on Nomos
summary: Dark Glimmer chat with streamed answers and reasoning, exact multi-turn history, cancellation and measured KV session-store counters. Workspace/emotion probes and steering remain unconnected; demo/recorded readouts are explicit.
source: Original local Nomos interface · Muse/Meta-inspired, not official Meta UI
highlights: Real streamed Glimmer chat and expandable provider reasoning
Between-turn RAM/NVMe occupancy and cumulative KV reuse counters
Supplied Muse mascot as a local, subtle chat watermark
Emotion-target Dock with persistent on/off preview selections, not applied steering
Freeze, follow and exact-frame trace inspection
Concept/layer matrix and signed emotion-concept scores
Phone inspection sheet and reduced-motion motion fallback

review.summary: Real chat/reasoning/KV integration plus isolated failure controls for exact history, Stop, malformed/truncated SSE and source separation. Browser layouts and prior demo controls verified. Steering is not applied; no safety or loaded-binary attestation claim.

findings.title: Workspace/emotion probes and steering are not connected
findings.detail: Live chat and server-reported KV counters work. Demo probe values remain synthetic, imported metadata unverified. No safety classifier, probe calibration, steering or loaded-kernel attestation.

findings.title: Production integration and dependency review remain
findings.detail: Local-only proxy: no public authentication, durable chats, automatic recovery, tools or attachments. Historical npm audit reported low-severity entries; no full security/a11y/performance clearance.

about.description: An independent dark, chat-first interface for Muse on Nomos, using ordinary local Svelte components. A contextual inspector shows concept projections, layers, raw signed emotion-concept scores and trace provenance without claiming that inspection proves safety.
about.architecture: Svelte 5/SvelteKit adapter-node SSR, Tailwind 4 tokens, Bits UI and local AI Elements/Magic/Fancy. Private fixed-upstream proxy streams OpenAI SSE, preserves raw reasoning/answer history and polls actual KV counters between turns. Independent demo/recorded inspection format; no remote component registry.
limitations: Workspace/emotion readouts are unconnected; real chat/health/KV counters are separate.
Emotion steering controls select UI intent only; no activation vectors or steering transport exist.
Imported metadata is self-reported, never serving-process attestation.
Probe scores are not emotion probabilities, feelings, thought transcripts or safety verdicts.
Live context is in-memory only, bounded to 64 messages/64,000 UTF-16 code units; reload or leaving live mode clears it.
Reasoning stays on and is sent back verbatim; model text is escaped plain text, not rendered Markdown.
No kernel/GPU changes, public deployment or external repository push.
